description: Create an onchain swap between two assets. Endpoint set provisional, expand once docs stabilize.

amount.description: Amount of from_asset to swap, in the asset's smallest unit (string to preserve precision)

from_asset.description: Asset symbol or contract address being sold (e.g. ETH, USDC)

slippage_bps.description: Maximum acceptable slippage in basis points

to_asset.description: Asset symbol or contract address being bought

wallet_id.description: CDP wallet id sourcing the swap
